rationale: C13 plausibly supplied a material drafting template. Its Economic Stabilization Agency provisions use the same core sequence later adapted for the Federal Civil Defense Administration: create an agency, place an Administrator at its head, assign a basic mission, enumerate planning, public-information, consultation, and coordination functions, require government agencies to furnish information, and define operative terms. The repeated language and parallel administrative machinery go beyond a merely shared defense context. C10 and C04 contain close establishment, interagency-cooperation, compensation, and funding clauses, but their temporary commission/board structures are less similar to the child's operating administration.

shared_material.child_excerpt: There is hereby established the Federal Civil Defense Administration... At the head of the Administration shall be an Administrator who shall be appointed by the President
shared_material.parent_excerpt: There is hereby created a new and independent agency to be known as the Economic Stabilization Agency... There shall be at the head of the Agency an Economic Stabilization Administrator... who shall be appointed by the President
shared_material.explanation: Closely parallel agency-creation and leadership language, adapted to a different emergency function.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The basic purpose of the Administration shall be to promote and facilitate the civil defense of the United States... Prepare comprehensive Federal plans and programs... Disseminate civil-defense information
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Administrator shall seek to preserve and maintain the stabilization of the economy. To this end he shall: (1) Plan and develop both short and long-range... policies and measures... (2) Inform the public...
shared_material.explanation: Both state an agency mission and immediately implement it through an enumerated sequence beginning with planning and public information.

shared_material.child_excerpt: All departments and agencies of the Federal Government are authorized and directed to cooperate with the Administrator and... to furnish the Administrator such information and Assistance as he may require
shared_material.parent_excerpt: All agencies of the Government... shall furnish to each officer to whom functions are delegated or assigned by this Executive order such information... as he may deem necessary
shared_material.explanation: Parallel government-wide information-supply machinery supporting the newly assigned functions.

shared_material.child_excerpt: As used in this order, the terms "State" and "States" include...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: As used in this Executive order: (a) The term "functions" includes...
shared_material.explanation: Both conclude their administrative scheme with express definitions tailored to the directive.
